input.command:
git add server/src/services/projects.ts server/src/routes/projects.ts server/src/routes/agents.ts tests/cf-smoke/cf-smoke.spec.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(server): resolve projects by URL key + permissive agent middleware

Same bug class as agents (URL key like \"onboarding\" vs UUID), now fixed
for projects too:

- projectService.getById: UUID branch (existing) + URL-key branch that
  scans projects and matches via deriveProjectUrlKey. Route handlers
  enforce assertCompanyAccess on the resolved project.

- 6 project handlers: replace raw \`id\` passed to downstream service
  calls (svc.update / listWorkspaces / createWorkspace / updateWorkspace /
  removeWorkspace / remove) with the resolved \`existing.id\`. The
  router.param middleware on Node already normalizes; this fixes the CF
  auto-bridge path which skips Express middleware.

- agents.ts router.param middleware: when no companyId is available to
  scope a shortname lookup, leave the rawId in place instead of throwing
  unprocessable. The route handler's svc.getById is the single source
  of resolution + 404 behaviour, and now handles URL keys without
  requiring a company scope. Same change for the not-found case.

Smoke suite: extend project-scoped reads to also exercise URL keys
(GET /api/projects/:urlKey, GET /api/projects/:urlKey/workspaces).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit project URL key + agent middleware fixes
